title: Anthony Creek Horse Camp

services.name: Big Creek Horse Camp
services.desc: Anthony Creek Horse Camp is located near the gently rolling waters of Anthony Creek. Whether blanketed in bright wildflowers in the spring or vivid colors in the fall, the scenery at Anthony Creek never disappoints. Anthony Creek offers primitive-woods camping. There are no hookups or showers at the campground. Potable water is available from the campground spigot, about 1/2 mile away, and water for horses can be collected from the nearby stream. However, visitors must bring their own drinking water.The nearby Cades Cove area offers additional amenities. A valid parking tag is required for any vehicle parking for more than 15 minutes in Great Smoky Mountains National Park. Front country

blurb: Anthony Creek Horse Camp offers camping facilities for visitors with horses. Guests can camp with their horses and enjoy the natural surroundings. The site provides access to trails suitable for horseback riding.
